keyEvents.text: Goal! Derby County 0, Norwich City 1. Anthony Musaba (Norwich City) right footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal.
Goal! Derby County 0, Norwich City 2. Paris Maghoma (Norwich City) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Jack Stacey.
Ryan Nyambe (Derby County) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Derby County 0, Norwich City 3. Darlin Yongwa (Norwich City) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner.
Substitution, Derby County. Lewis Travis replaces Alex Mowatt.
Substitution, Derby County. Jack Robinson replaces Isaac Gordon.
Substitution, Derby County. Mohammed Fuseini replaces Oscar Fraulo.
Second Half begins Derby County 0, Norwich City 3.
Substitution, Norwich City. Lucien Mahovo replaces Andre Brooks.
Substitution, Norwich City. Jovon Makama replaces Paris Maghoma.
Delay in match because of an injury Sam Szmodics (Derby County).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Derby County. Filip Bilbija replaces Sam Szmodics because of an injury.
Goal! Derby County 0, Norwich City 4. Jovon Makama (Norwich City) right footed shot from outside the box to the high centre of the goal.
Substitution, Norwich City. Oscar Schwartau replaces Anthony Musaba.
Substitution, Norwich City. Ante Crnac replaces Mathias Kvistgaarden.
Substitution, Derby County. Rhian Brewster replaces Henrik Meister.
